name: matrimony-microservice
description: Turborepo monorepo running 3 frontends (Girija-Kalyana, Sangam-sathi, Shree-ganda) and matrimony-service backend concurrently

scripts.dev:concurrently: concurrently -k -n "girija,sangam,shree,matrimony" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,green" "npm run dev --workspace=girija-kalyana" "npm run dev --workspace=sangam-sathi" "npm run dev --workspace=shree-ganda" "npm run dev --workspace=matrimony-service"
